companyDescription: AI-driven drug discovery (TechBio) · REC-4881 posted positive Phase 2 data in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) · partnered with Sanofi/Roche ($500M+ milestones delivered) and Citeline for AI-enhanced trials
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Near the lower end of its 52-week range ($2.77-$7.18) despite genuinely positive pipeline news — a real disconnect between fundamentals and price that one bearish analyst attributes to the stock still being up to 67% overvalued on a different basis.
summary: Recursion's REC-4881 posted positive Phase 2 data in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), a rare disease with no approved therapies — genuinely good news for a company whose AI-driven drug discovery model has been more promise than proof to date. The company's partnered pipeline with Sanofi and Roche has delivered over $500M in milestone payments, and a new Citeline partnership targets $100M in AI-enhanced-trial inflows by year-end. Despite this, the stock trades near its 52-week low, and one analyst has flagged it as up to 67% overvalued on a separate valuation basis post-update — a real bear case, not just noise. 5-9 analysts cluster around a $6.57-7.00 consensus target (+118-133% from here), with a wider $10.75 outlier. Q2 earnings Aug 11, 2026 is the next real catalyst.
